before.requirement: Reach one-line pretty serialization of an empty object.
before.reason: Before the change, pretty formatting always appends a newline after the opening brace, including for an empty object.

after.requirement: Reach one-line pretty serialization of a parsed empty object such as {}.
after.reason: For an empty object, the changed formatter skips both pretty newline sites and appends the closing brace. The old harness cannot reach this behavior because its serialization call has too many arguments.

claims.reason: The frozen one-line empty-object behavior is absent before and supported after. The same old harness has a build blocker after the change, so no input can reach it.
